x: Changtang, also known as the Northern Tibetan Plateau, is a part of the high altitude Tibetan Plateau with highlands and lakes. It extends from western and northern Tibet into the southern edges of Xinjiang as well as Changthang district in southeastern Ladakh of India.
Tong Tso or Dong Co is a plateau lake in Gêrzê County, Tibet Autonomous Region. The name of lake means "Desolate Lake" in Standard Tibetan. The lake has a total area of about 87.7 square kilometers.
